source_policy: Only encode rules supported by linked Microsoft Minecraft Creator documentation. A missing mapping means unknown, not unsupported.

notes: Preview feature; verify target game support.
Microsoft documentation notes metadata.author(s) is currently required by V3 processing.

memory_tier.notes: Each tier represents 250 MB; documentation says this is planned to be replaced by memory_performance_tier.

notes: Settings support is documented as experimental for behavior packs.
Resource-pack settings can be accessed through documented Molang queries.

script_api.policy: Show three evidence states separately: exact mappings explicitly listed in Microsoft's versioning reference; release-note evidence explicitly stated for a release; and unknown when neither source documents the target. Never promote release-note evidence to an exact mapping or infer unsupported status.
notes: Beta API versions do not guarantee backward compatibility and may require the Beta APIs experiment.
Internal APIs are not supported for custom behavior packs.
Do not infer an API version for a Minecraft release missing from the mapping.

Coverage includes documented historical stable mappings and selected 1.26.x release-note evidence. Preview builds are recorded separately; all other targets remain unknown until official evidence is added.

latest_documented_stable.evidence: Microsoft Learn lists 2.10.0 as latest stable module and lists 2.12.0-beta for preview 1.26.60; this is not a guarantee that every target game build supports it.

1.26.40.meaning: Microsoft's Minecraft 1.26.40 Creator Update Notes explicitly say this release ships @minecraft/server v2.9.0. This is release-note evidence, not an entry in the separate historical versioning table.

1.26.0.meaning: Microsoft's Minecraft 1.26.0 Creator Update Notes explicitly record @minecraft/server v2.5.0. This is release-note evidence, not an entry in the separate historical versioning table.

1.26.20.meaning: Microsoft's Minecraft 1.26.20 Creator Update Notes explicitly record @minecraft/server v2.7.0. This is release-note evidence, not an entry in the separate historical versioning table.

1.26.50.meaning: Minecraft Bedrock 1.26.50 changelog lists @minecraft/server 2.10.0 as released and 2.11.0-beta as beta. This records the stable module only; it does not imply every add-on is compatible.

1.26.60-preview.30.meaning: Microsoft's Script API changelog lists @minecraft/server 2.12.0-beta for Minecraft 1.26.60-preview.30. This is preview/beta evidence, not stable-release compatibility.

file_formats.rule: A JSON file's format_version describes that file type's data contract; it is not generally the same as the installed Minecraft version.
file_formats.note: Template defaults are starter examples only, not a guarantee of latest schema or compatibility with every component.

online_update.cache_policy: Use bundled data when available; retain last valid cached data when offline. Never execute downloaded code.

changes: Stricter entity JSON validation: invalid data in affected components and AI goals can prevent loading when entity format_version is 1.26.40 or later.
minecraft:multi_block trait and minecraft:instrument_sound block component moved out of experimental.
Ships @minecraft/server 2.9.0; @minecraft/server 2.10.0 and @minecraft/server-ui 2.2.0 are beta in these notes.
Duplicate feature identifiers in one behavior pack now produce a content-log error.
Pack files are compressed in archives and duplicate raw files in behavior/resource pack folders were removed.
Minecraft adopted year-based version numbering in 2026; API and file schema version numbers remain separate systems.
Released @minecraft/server v2.5.0, including additional stable block component types and player swing events.
EntityHurtAfterEvent now fires when damage amount is zero; fixes were made to ItemStack and Entity getComponents behavior in older script versions.
Hotfix improves Nintendo Switch network stability and fixes a launch issue on some iOS devices.
Fixes invisible inventory items under certain non-default graphics settings.
Players in Spectator Mode are no longer hit by projectiles; cushions in unloaded chunks no longer disappear after reload.
Fixes an add-on achievement issue affecting older Marketplace worlds at and after version 26.50.
No @minecraft/server version mapping is inferred because this changelog does not state one.
Main Wilderness Bound update with new world features and technical changes.
Entity JSON schemas become stricter for affected components and AI goals using format_version 1.26.50 and later.
Several entity, block, projectile, UI, and stability behaviors changed; validate add-ons against the target format_version.

latest_bedrock_release.note: Latest stable Bedrock release recorded in the official release changelog. Script API version is not inferred from this game version.
